paper_title: Revisiting the bound on axion-photon coupling from Globular Clusters
notes: Stellar bound from R parameter of 39 Galactic Globular Clusters. Main result: g_agamma < 0.66e-10 GeV^-1 at 95% CL, valid for axion mass below a few keV (Primakoff production). The bound is mass-independent over a wide range (up to ~10 keV). Data points represent the flat exclusion across the mass range; only the upper bound value is given (no g-vs-mass table).
